mapper.update:
UPDATE ai_agent_message
response = #{response}, metrics_json = #{metricsJson}, status = #{status}, force_stop = #{forceStop}, files_json = #{filesJson}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, update_time = now()
